name: skills-sh
description: Browse and install community skills from skills.sh. Search, preview, and manage external skill packages.
author: PersonalClaw

launches.why: Without a skills.sh API key, or when the skills.sh API fails, each search you make runs skills find with what you typed.
Without a skills.sh API key, showing or installing a skill clones its repository from GitHub into a temporary folder, which is removed once its files are read.

writes.why: npx keeps the skills package it downloads, and the packages it depends on, in npm's own cache folder.

x-meta.label: API Key
x-meta.help: Skills.sh API key for search and install. Get one at skills.sh/settings. Without one, each search runs the skills command line through npx, which downloads and runs the skills npm package, and showing or installing a skill clones its repository from GitHub.
